texts: The bones of the old graveyard lie under the water in the Sunken Cove.

fields.sentence: The bones of the old graveyard lie under the water in the Sunken Cove.

q2_gaps: An entity-attached position head (surface preposition, here `Under`) whose bearer is a DEFINITE PLURAL: *Where a THING is* shows the position atom only with singular bearers, and the plural distributive mandate is written for descriptive modifiers and copular predicates. Whether the position rides the group symbol or becomes a (PartOf $x <group>) rule is unstated.
review.notes: "under" correctly avoids LocatedIn (containment-only) and "in the Sunken Cove" is attached to the water NP, the nearer-NP reading the stacked-place rule suggests. "of the old graveyard" takes the opaque Possession rather than PartOf, a licensed call under the part/component test.
